description: Caller asks to book on Dr. Rao's leave day (October 9), then clarifies to a valid day.
turns: Dr. Rao ke saath 9 October ko appointment chahiye.
Accha, 10 ko Saturday hai na? Woh karein.

expected.notes: Dr. Rao is on leave October 9. The caller self-corrects to October 10 (Saturday). A naive agent might either try to book on the 9th and fail without retrying, or ignore the self-correction. The correct behavior is to detect the leave day, accept the correction, and book on Oct 10.
